import pandas as pd
import sqlite3

# Load consumption data from CSV
consumption_df = pd.read_csv('csv/yearmonth.csv')

# Load SME CustomerIDs from SQLite database
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/customers.db')
sme_customers_df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'", conn)
conn.close()

# Get unique SME CustomerIDs
sme_customer_ids = set(sme_customers_df['CustomerID'])

# Filter consumption data for SME customers
sme_consumption_df = consumption_df[consumption_df['CustomerID'].isin(sme_customer_ids)]

# Filter for year 2013 (Date format is YYYYMM)
sme_2013_df = sme_consumption_df[sme_consumption_df['Date'].astype(str).str.startswith('2013')]

# Calculate average monthly consumption
average_consumption = sme_2013_df['Consumption'].mean()

print(f"Average monthly consumption for SME customers in 2013: {average_consumption}")
print(f"Number of records: {len(sme_2013_df)}")
